Section-by-section image and content matching against the reference design

title: AITS Website
tagline: Backend architecture for an AI-driven customer support platform.
description: Backend and content-management foundation for an AI customer support platform, built after a focused study period on AI chatbots, agents, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — applying those concepts to real authentication and API architecture rather than just tutorials.
features: Custom User model extending Django's AbstractUser for role-based access control
Core content models for Hero Section, Tech Features, and Contact Inquiry, serialized via DRF
PostgreSQL migrated from SQLite and containerized with Docker Compose
Django Admin dashboard set up for content management
CORS-configured API layer for secure Next.js frontend integration
challenges: Migrated the project database from SQLite to a Dockerized PostgreSQL setup
Resolved environment/SECRET_KEY configuration issues by restructuring the .env setup
Fixed a TemplateDoesNotExist routing issue during initial API wiring
Configured CORS to establish secure frontend-backend communication
role: Backend Developer Intern — designed the custom auth and content-management architecture, applying prior research into AI agents, LLM APIs, and MCP as groundwork for the platform's AI customer-support direction. Ongoing project.

title: Idara Al-Khair (IAK) Chatbot
tagline: An animated AI chatbot widget with a holographic avatar, built for iak.ngo.
description: A chatbot front-end interface for Idara Al-Khair's nonprofit website, built around a fully custom-animated avatar. Iterated through several visual directions — a breathing gradient circle, a glowing morphing blob — before landing on a holographic, iridescent design, all implemented in pure CSS to keep the widget fast and dependency-free.
features: Holographic, iridescent avatar built from layered conic-gradients with slow hue-rotate shimmer
Organic breathing and morphing animations for a 'living' avatar feel
Entirely CSS-based animation — no Three.js or WebGPU, so bundle size and performance stay untouched
Iteratively refined avatar design to match a specific holographic reference image
challenges: Recreating an organic, glowing, almost-3D visual effect using only CSS, instead of a heavy Three.js/WebGPU component
Iterating through multiple avatar concepts (solid circle → glowing blob → holographic shimmer) based on visual feedback
Keeping the animation lightweight enough to not affect load time or performance on any device
role: Designed and implemented the chatbot's animated avatar and front-end UI for iak.ngo, iterating through several visual directions to match a holographic reference design while keeping the implementation lightweight.

title: Visitor Management System (VMS)
tagline: A modern visitor management system with QR check-in, real-time dashboard, and smart visitor tracking.
description:
Visitor Management System (VMS) is a full-stack web application designed to streamline visitor registration and management for offices, schools, hospitals, and organizations.

The system provides receptionist-based manual check-in, QR code self check-in, pre-scheduled visits, duplicate visitor detection, real-time notifications using WebSockets, analytics dashboard, and host management.

Built with Next.js, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and JWT Authentication, the application delivers a fast, secure, and scalable visitor management experience.
features: Receptionist dashboard with live visitor updates
challenges: Implemented real-time communication using Django Channels and WebSockets
Built duplicate visitor detection using CNIC, phone, and email priority
Integrated QR code based visitor check-in
Designed secure JWT authentication
Managed Dockerized full-stack deployment
Created scalable REST APIs using Django REST Framework
Connected Next.js frontend with Django backend
Implemented role-based access for Admin and Receptionist
